system.name: ODS (test-time adaptation with Open-world Data Shift, AODS setup)
system.one_liner: Test-time adaptation when both the input distribution and the label distribution shift during testing; ODS decouples the mixed shifts and handles each.

content.variant_note: a problem-setting figure: a training phase and a testing phase, with thumbnail groups whose style and class mix change from one test segment to the next
content.argues: At test time both the input distribution D(X) and the label distribution D(Y) can shift from segment to segment, and the pre-trained model has to keep adapting to both.
content.subject: A model trained on source data, then adapting along a test stream whose image style and class mix change.

encoding.color_means: Green = training (the data box outline and the arrow into the model); blue = testing (the segment box outlines and the adaptation arrow); grey = the model.
encoding.line_style_means: Black dashed rectangles = the two phases; dashed lines inside the data boxes split the classes (vertical in training, horizontal in testing); solid rounded boxes = datasets or stream segments; thick block arrows = training hand-over and adaptation over time.
encoding.shape_means: Rounded boxes with a title set into the top border = a dataset or a stream segment; grey rounded rectangle = model; block arrow = a process over time.
encoding.marker_means: D_0(X, Y), D_1(X, Y) ... D_T1(X, Y) and D_{T_{n-1}+1}(X, Y) ... D_{T_n}(X, Y) give the data distribution of each box; the ellipsis stands for the segments between.
encoding.emphasis: The long blue arrow with its label spans the whole test stream, and the changing group sizes of horses and cars between the boxes make the label shift visible.
reusable_patterns: thumbnail groups split by a dashed line into classes, group sizes changing between boxes to show label shift

lessons.what_to_learn: Define a learning setting with two framed phases and one model box straddling them, then show the test stream as titled segments of fanned thumbnails split by a dashed line into classes whose group sizes change, so covariate and label shift are visible without drawing any method.
lessons.suits: Problem-setting or protocol figures for distribution shift, continual or test-time learning, where the point is how the data change over time.

evidence: The pre-trained model will continually adapt to the changing covariate and label distributions in the testing phase.
samples from the same class may differ dramatically at different moments

summary: ODS addresses test-time adaptation when both the covariate distribution D(X) and the label distribution D(Y) shift while the model is being tested. Figure 1 demonstrates this AODS setup in two stacked dashed boxes. In the Training Phase a green Training Data box D_0(X, Y) holds six thumbnails of two classes and hands them over a bent green arrow to a grey Model box. In the Testing Phase a long blue arrow labelled Adapt to shifted D(X) and D(Y) runs over a stream of blue segment boxes, Snowy day and Downtown, whose photos differ in style and in the share of horses and cars. Only the setting is drawn, no method.
summary_zh: ODS 研究测试时输入分布和标签分布同时偏移的适应问题。图 1 用上下两个虚线框演示该设定：训练阶段的数据交给灰色模型，测试阶段一条蓝色长箭头贯穿 Snowy day、Downtown 等片段，图片风格和马、车比例都在变化。
notes: Pre-screen kinds kept. The two dashed phase boxes are counted as panels; the Model box sits on their shared border. The two blue segment boxes are nested units of the Testing Phase and are recorded as lanes, not panels. No method is drawn, hence is_contribution is mostly false or null.
